messages.content: Morning! Did you finish planning the hiking route for Saturday?
Almost. The canyon trail looks best - about six miles with the waterfall overlook at the halfway point.
Waterfall overlook sounds perfect. Should we start early to beat the heat?
Definitely. Trailhead by seven means we finish the hiking before noon.
Found a great recipe for trail snacks - oat bars with honey and dried cherries.
That recipe sounds way better than store-bought bars. Send it over?
Sent! The recipe takes twenty minutes and makes a dozen bars.
Making a double batch tonight then. Hiking fuel sorted.
Checked the weather for Saturday - clear skies, low eighties by noon.
Perfect hiking weather. I'll bring the good camera for the waterfall.
Nice. Meet at the trailhead parking lot at seven sharp?
Seven sharp. Bringing extra water and the oat bars.
